flaws.description: Swapped the x-axis and y-axis label strings so the chart now claims the x-axis shows 'Governance Indicator' and the y-axis shows 'Impact Score (Positive/Negative)', contradicting the actual axis mapping.
Swapped the two hex colours in the palette list so Positive Impact bars render red (#E15759) and Negative Impact bars render blue (#4E79A7), contradicting the summary's stated colour coding.
Changed the Regulatory Framework positive impact value from 67.5 to 30.4 (67.5 * 0.45), corrupting one bar in the tornado chart while leaving the table unchanged.
